mechanism: Any fixed label-independent qutrit POVM has nonzero-secret Gram supported on opposite-secret pairs with diagonal d<=2/3 and opposite entry |eta|<=d. Product block norms and a separately charged zero secret bound any classical joint classifier at the native copy budget.
research_decision: Do not pursue blind product basis changes at M=nr-2 as a constant population-advantage decoder. Investigate label-sensitive local measurements, outcome-adaptive policies or collective observables instead, with honest cost and source accounting.
falsifiers: A positive complete fixed POVM violates the scalar coherence inequalities.
The native full-label centered Gram has support beyond equal or opposite nonzero secrets and the zero diagonal.
A product of certified POVMs violates the paired-block operator-norm or classifier transfer bound.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independently review arbitrary POVM coherence bounds, composite-ring root orthogonality, product opposite-secret blocks and source-average classifier transfer.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: Quantum POVMs must be fixed independently of all native labels and earlier outcomes. This is not a lower bound for label-aware local measurements, adaptive LOCC, collective measurements or chosen/retained label laws.
proof_obligations.PO-RANDOMNESS: Condition on shared public measurement randomness before product factorization; independence of the unconditional records is not assumed.
proof_obligations.PO-SURPLUS: Polynomial sample surplus can make this gate vacuous. Do not promote a copy-density bound to computational hardness or a prohibition on all polynomial-time algorithms.
proof_obligations.PO-CERTIFICATES: Supplied scalar invariants are assumptions unless their actual complete positive POVM has been certified. Finite exact rational controls are not a restriction of the general derivation.
proof_obligations.PO-NOVELTY: No novelty, accepted algorithm or quantum speedup claim; independent literature and mathematical review remain necessary.
